mkdir -p /target/etc/iptables
cat > /target/etc/iptables/rules.v4 ‹ 'EOF'
*filter
: INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:FORNARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A OUTPUT -0 10 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -p icmp -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -p udp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 53 -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -p udp --dport 67:68 -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -p udp --dport 123 -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -d 10.0.0.0/8 -j ACCEFT
OUTPUT -d 172.16.0.0/12 -j ACCEPT
A OUTPUT -d 192.168.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
A OUTPUT -d 169.254.0.0/16 -j ACCEPT
OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 80 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
-A OUTPUT -p tcp --dport 443 -j REJECT --reject-with icmp-port-unreachable
COMMIT
EOF
cat › /target/etc/iptables/rules.v6 < 'EOF"
*filter
: INPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
:FORWARD ACCEPT [0:0]
:OUTPUT ACCEPT [0:0]
-A OUTPUT -0 10 -j ACCEPT
-A OUTPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED, RELATED -j ACCEPT
COMMIT
EOF
chmod 0644/target/etc/iptables/rules.v4 /target/etc/iptables/rules.v6
